evidence.dom: 10-K FY2025(ndsn-20251031.htm) Item1 Competitive Conditions: 『We operate in a competitive global marketplace and compete with many large, well-established and highly competitive manufacturers and service providers. ... Our equipment is sold in competition with a wide variety of alternative bonding, sealing, finishing, coating, processing, testing, inspecting and fluid control techniques. Potential uses for our equipment include any production processes that require preparation, modification or curing of surfaces; dispensing, application, processing or control of fluids and materials; or testing and inspecting for quality.』 続けて『Many factors influence our competitive position, including pricing, product quality, and service. We maintain a leadership position in our business segments...』。**自社シェア%の開示なし／上位N社合計シェアの開示なし／競合の実名列挙すらなし**——原本に数値が無いため70/85/100は主張不能(『leadership position』は順位の自称でシェアの証拠にならない=v9.9.41規約4)。他方、提出書類自身が「many large, well-established and highly competitive manufacturers and service providers」＝**多数の企業**が同等の装置・サービスを供給しており、かつ「a wide variety of alternative bonding, sealing, finishing... techniques」＝**同等品を多数が製造可能**なうえ代替工法一般とも競合する、と**構造的に分散**を述べており、自社シェア40%以上・上位2社≥80%・上位3社≥80%のいずれも成立しえない → 市場構造=競争(<40%)＝刻み50。IPS/MFS/ATSの3セグメントに区別なく同一の記述が置かれており、全社が同じ刻みに落ちるため50を確定(v9.9.41規約1・3)
evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上(FY2025 10-K Note—Operating Segments and Geographic Area Data、総額2,791,687千$): Industrial Precision Solutions 1,331,792=47.7% / Medical and Fluid Solutions 835,385=29.9% / Advanced Technology Solutions 624,510=22.4%。顧客集中『In 2025, no single customer accounted for ten percent or more of our sales』(Item1 Principal Products and Uses)。堀の本数=2と判定—— (1)精密分注・材料処理の装置プラットフォーム 70.1%(IPS 47.7%＋ATS 22.4%): 原本はIPSを『proprietary dispensing and material processing technology』、ATSを『This segment integrates our proprietary product technologies into the progressive stages of a customer's production processes, such as surface treatment, precisely controlled dispensing of material, and pre- and post-dispense test and inspection』と記し、**ATSはIPSと同一の自社中核技術を別の終端市場(半導体・電子実装)へ載せたもの**。終端市場・競合・損益が別でも共通中核技術に乗るものは1本(v9.9.41追加規約)。 (2)医療・流体コンポーネント 29.9%(MFS): 『components and device solutions for medical, life science, high-tech industrial, and other diverse end markets』——Medical Interventional Solutions(engineered shafts, medical tubing, balloons, nitinol devices, cardiovascular cannula)・Medical Fluid Components(needle-free infusion valves, single-use fluid transfer)・Surgical Solutions は生産ライン用の資本設備ではなく**顧客の医療機器に組み込まれる単回使用部材**で、FDA/設計組込という別建ての障壁と消耗品型の経済性を持つ。装置プラットフォームが崩れても独立に生き残る。 → 独立した堀2本(各≥売上15%)＝85。※MFS内のEngineered Fluid Solutions(精密分注器・シリンジ/カートリッジ/チップ)は(1)と同型の技術だが内訳売上が非開示のため分割せず、セグメント単位で保守的に(2)へ含めた。最大顧客<10%・最大セグメント47.7%<80%につき50の要件(1製品≥80% or 最大顧客≥20%)には非該当
